build_av_wrapper_model: build an audio-visual wrapper model from video and audio backbone models with a shared projection dimension
create_head_projection: create a multi-layer linear projection head with ReLU activations for embedding dimensionality reduction
create_av_wrapper_module: create an AV_Wrapper module that processes video and audio inputs through separate models and optional projection layers
run_av_wrapper_forward: run forward pass on video and audio tensors to get projected embeddings from both modalities
load_av_wrapper_checkpoint: load a pretrained audio-visual wrapper model from a checkpoint file with DataParallel state dict
